Product Disclaimer: Product packaging may vary.
With the boss away, there was no one left to protect us from all sorts of inter-office dangers—desk hoverers, scope creepers, and most dangerous of all, encroaching deadlines. So we gathered all the non-foils together as raw materials to fortify our workspaces. How many top-tier non-foil cards with incredible new art are in this bundle? Easy. All of them. Which is coincidentally, also a desk fort’s worth.
Contents:
• 1x Secret Lair x SpongeBob SquarePants: Legends of Bikini Bottom
• 1x Secret Lair x SpongeBob SquarePants: Internet Sensation
• 1x Secret Lair x SpongeBob SquarePants: Lands Under the Sea
• 1x They Grow Up So Fast
• 1x Garden Buds
• 1x Tragic Romance
• 1x Twisted Toons
• 1x Pick ’Em and Stick ’Em
• 1x Secret Lair High: Class of ’87

When purchasing this unique product, please keep in mind that this Secret Lair Drop Series Sealed Product will ship out to you after the seller receives the product directly from Wizards of the Coast.
